title: A Flow accepts ANY of a set of models, and the user picks which installed one runs it
description: FABIO, 2026-08-20, choosing option 3 of three: 'let's go with three. User can select the model. Best place to put it is probably with a dropdown in the slide over before opening the flow.' THE PROBLEM: `requiredModels` is an exact-id AND list (flowsRegistry.js getFlowAvailability - `(flow.requiredModels || []).filter(id => !installed.includes(id))`). Character Sheet declares ['krea2','klein-4b'], so a user who installed ONLY krea2-nsfw fails the gate, sees 'needs models', and is asked to download a second 12.25GB base that is the same architecture with a different bake. TWO HALVES, and the second is the real work. (1) THE GATE accepts an any-of SET. Minimal shape: an entry that is itself an array means any-of - `requiredModels: [['krea2','krea2-nsfw'], 'klein-4b']` - which needs no new registry concept and leaves every existing single-id flow untouched. DO NOT REACH FOR `modelFamily`: MPI-316 deliberately REMOVED it from both krea2 cards because that field drives the H/B/L tier letter, and the two cards are CONTENT variants (SFW/NSFW), not tiers - re-adding it renders 'Krea 2 NSFW H' again, which is the exact bug MPI-316 fixed. (2) THE PICKED MODEL MUST ACTUALLY REACH THE GRAPH, and today it cannot: flow_character_sheet.json node 55 is a UNETLoader with `unet_name: 'krea2_raw_int8_convrot.safetensors'` HARDCODED and no `Input_*` title, so nothing injects it. The NSFW arm needs 'lustify-v10-krea-raw-int8_convrot.safetensors' (dep krea2-raw-transformer-nsfw). So this card either titles that node injectable or routes it through an MpiNodes switch - a workflow change plus an injection param, not a dropdown alone. A UI-only implementation would render a picker that silently changes nothing, which is the failure mode to design against. ALSO IN SCOPE: `settingsModel: 'krea2'` on the FlowDef names WHOSE LoRA rack the Flow opens and whose slots reach commandExecutor as `loraModelId` (MPI-504) - it must follow the picked model, or a user on the NSFW card edits the SFW rack and gets no LoRAs. PLACEMENT IS DECIDED: an MpiDropdown in the Flow Library's slide-over detail panel, shown BEFORE the flow opens, listing only the INSTALLED members of the set; a single installed member needs no picker. Where the choice persists (project.json vs a flow-level store vs not at all) is open. Every control is a component (MPI-582) - MpiDropdown, never a bare <select>. PROCEDURE: docs/playbooks/add-flow/ (this changes the FlowDef contract, so 01-descriptor-and-ops.md is the page to update) plus docs/workflow-authoring/ for the injectable node.
